verdict.rationale: Hatchet clearly supports multiple languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Ruby) per GitHub docs and community confirmation of SDKs in Python/TypeScript/Go, and Python SDK install is independently verified via probe. However, there is no evidence directly addressing feature parity across SDKs — no changelog or docs comparing capabilities language-by-language, and one commenter had to ask if it works beyond Python, suggesting parity isn't obviously documented. Missing for 10: explicit feature-parity documentation/matrix across SDKs, Go/Ruby SDK reference docs comparable to the Python reference, and independent confirmation of parity from hands-on users.
